newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Westgold says no Bolnisi bid decision.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Westgold says no Bolnisi bid decision.

text.p: Westgold Resources NL said on Monday it has made no decision to make a takeover bid for Bolnisi Gold NL.
Westgold announced earlier on Monday it has acquired 20.12 million shares in Bolnisi, representing 14.99 percent of Bolnisi's capital.
"The company advises that no decision to make a takeover bid for Bolnisi has been made," Westgold said in a statement to the Australian Stock Exchange.
"The company will keep the market informed in relation to any developments with regard to its investment in Bolnisi and in relation to any other market sensitive matters," Westgold said.
Westgold shares were 0.5 cents firmer at 26 cents at 1.25 p.m. (0225 GMT), while Bolnisi shares were two cents higher at 18 cents.
